phase: Zero-API process/transport foundation; not a live-agent study

bounds.connection_deadline_scope: Client and socket/frame I/O only; server mutation completion may exceed it while SQLite waits up to ten seconds

persistence: SQLite WAL/FULL transactions, immutable artifact/event hashes, source command replay binding; peer-owned directory lock and fsynced routing configuration
faults: Transport-denial links at node boundary, actual process death, transaction-boundary forced exit and lost acknowledgment; no kernel/WAN/host-loss emulation claim
authentication: Ephemeral shared HMAC capability authenticates trusted cluster messages and request/response binding; no TLS or Byzantine producer guarantee
remaining: Source-bound agent/controller integration and shared authority adapter qualification
Equivalent measured healthy capacity and exact live fault/placement resource controls
Durable cross-restart measurement and explicit ambiguous-mutation reconciliation in live adapters
Independent task-family sampling, powered stopping, budget and held-out acceptance
Separate autonomous tool-loop and multi-host comparisons
no_simulation_latency: Actual process/socket behavior is observed; local time is not model, WAN or production latency.
measurement_limits: stats_since_boot reset after restart; live fault comparisons require durable telemetry or external accumulation across every boot
Client timeout leaves mutation outcome ambiguous; reconcile using stable command IDs/content bindings rather than treating timeout as rollback
Manual incoming-merge crash replay and within-batch event reorder are narrower than autonomous receive-crash recovery and network packet reordering
broker_acknowledgment: Receiver-local commit only; asynchronous replication, no quorum/consensus or simultaneous unreplicated source-and-broker loss guarantee
